assumptions: USD million. Fictional White Reed Hospital. Toy payer retrospective recoupment of prior-year reimbursement is a current estimate change, not restatement. Signed audit decision controls over appeal estimates.

evidence.text: [Annual income statement extract p.19] Inpatient revenue 180, outpatient 90 before retrospective recoupment. Direct costs 190, central operating expense 40. No depreciation outside those amounts. No tax or interest.

[Payer audit p.41] Payer reviews claims from prior year, confirms overpayment 12. Of that amount 8 cash already recouped by withholding from this year's ordinary remittance; 4 due next year. Hospital has no enforceable right to reverse the audit determination at reporting date.
[Appeal register p.42] Hospital appealed 5 of the 12; no final decision, no recognized recovery. Draft appeal success estimate 80% not approved.

[Collection ledger p.53] Ordinary current-year gross payer/customer cash collections before withholding 260. Opening receivable 25; all 270 current consideration billed. The 8 withholding settles prior-year recoupment obligation, not current invoice discount.

[Accounting note p.63] Record 12 reduction in current revenue and obligation, extinguish 8 against withheld cash; receivable bridge uses gross ordinary collections 260. No opening recoupment liability.
[Cost cash p.65] Direct cost paid 183, central expense paid 38. No other operating cash flow. No refunds beyond withholding.
[Management presentation p.8] Uses net bank deposit 252 as reduction in current AR, treats recoupment as additional direct cost, adds expected appeal 4 to revenue.

qas.question: Doanh thu năm nay sau adjustment từ payer audit đã ký?
qas.answer: 180+90−12=258 triệu USD; pending appeal chưa ghi.

qas.question: Operating result sau recoupment đúng classification và chi phí?
Phải thu ordinary billings cuối năm theo collection gross?
qas.answer: 25+270−260=35 triệu USD. 8 withheld là settlement riêng của recoupment.

qas.question: Closing recoupment obligation sau withholding?
Operating cash generation từ bank cash thực nhận và cash expense?
Nếu analyst dùng net collection 252 trong AR bridge và vẫn ghi liability 12, hãy nêu lỗi.
qas.answer: Net 252 bỏ settlement 8 khỏi gross receipts, làm AR thừa 8; liability chưa giảm 8. Dùng collection 260 cho AR và giảm obligation 8, bank cash 252.

qas.question: Có restate năm trước do phát hiện reimbursement overpayment?
qas.answer: Không tự restate: case quy định current estimate change. Final audit 12 giảm revenue hiện tại, không ghi pending appeal.

qas.question: Tính xác suất thực tế appeal thành công từ 80% draft được không?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ là estimate chưa approved, chưa có appeal outcome hoặc lịch sử calibration.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Harbor Kite Logistics. Toy group includes two wholly owned operating segments, intersegment services eliminated gross at billed amounts; no inventory profit remaining. Central overhead separate, segment EBITDA before depreciation.

evidence.text:
[Segment report p.24]
| Segment | External revenue | Intersegment revenue | Cash operating expense | D&A |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Road | 220 | 30 | 190 | 15 |
| Warehouse | 160 | 20 | 145 | 12 |
[Internal billing p.39] Road charges Warehouse 30 for transport; Warehouse charges Road 20 for cross-docking. Road expense includes 20; Warehouse expense includes 30. All services consumed in period.
[Corporate p.40] Central cash overhead 18, corporate D&A 3; group interest 20, tax 8. No allocation to segment expense. No other P&L.
[Prior year p.25] Reported consolidated external revenue 350 and consolidated EBITDA 55. Prior intersegment amounts not disclosed.

[Cash p.47] External customer cash collections 370, group external cash operating payments 300 (including central); cash interest 20, cash tax 7, classified CFO. Cash capex 40. No other operating flows.

[KPI policy p.50] Group EBITDA = consolidated external revenue less consolidated cash operating expenses (accrual cost, excluding D&A). Segment EBITDA includes internal revenue and charges before central.
[Deck p.5] Adds all segment revenues to claim 430 group sales, subtracts internal revenue but leaves internal expenses intact for consolidated EBITDA.

qas.question: Doanh thu hợp nhất từ bảng segment khi loại intersegment?
Operating expense hợp nhất trước D&A sau internal elimination và central overhead?
EBITDA hợp nhất theo KPI policy?
LNST hợp nhất với D&A, interest, tax đầy đủ?
FCF nếu định nghĩa CFO trừ cash capex, CFO theo cash disclosed?
Phản biện cách deck loại internal sales nhưng giữ internal expense.
qas.answer: Eliminate matching revenue 50 và expense 50. Nếu chỉ giảm revenue, EBITDA bị thấp 50; internal services không tạo group external expense ngoài actual resource costs.

qas.question: Có dùng cash payment 300 thay accrual expense 303 để báo group EBITDA?
qas.answer: Không. Cash 300 khác accrual cost 303 do timing; EBITDA dựa P&L expense, không cash.

qas.question: Có tính intersegment revenue growth YoY?
qas.answer: Không. Prior chỉ external revenue và EBITDA, thiếu internal revenue riêng.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Juniper Signal. Toy tower sale qualifies as sale, seller recognizes stipulated disposal gain and lease expense under simplified operating rent model. No lease capitalization in this toy; avoid extrapolation to IFRS.

evidence.text: [Transaction note p.34] On July1 sold 1,000 towers for 400m cash, net carrying 300m, selling cost 10m paid. Control transfers; no retained ownership.

[P&L tower operations p.19] H1 towers generate third-party rental revenue 20m and opex 12m; H2 no rental revenue or tower opex after sale. H1 tower depreciation 10m already included in total group depreciation.
[Core operations p.20] Full-year telecom service revenue 900m, core cash-type expense 650m before new tower rent; group total depreciation 80m including H1 tower 10m.
[Lease p.35] From July1 network pays new owner 4m/month for access; full six months expensed and paid. No other lease cost.

[Cash flow p.43] CFO before new tower rent 180m, cash capex 120m (no sale cost in CFO); net sale cash proceeds 390m classified investing. Debt repayment 200m from proceeds; opening cash 50m; no other cash flows.

[Definitions p.46] Reported EBITDA excludes depreciation but includes disposal gain unless separately adjusted; recurring EBITDA excludes disposal gain only. Pro forma recurring EBITDA assumes no H1 rental/opex and full-year tower rent 48m, core expense unchanged.
[Deck p.3] Calls 390m cash proceeds disposal profit; forecasts recurring EBITDA by annualizing H2 tower rent but keeping H1 tower rental margin.

qas.question: Disposal gain từ sale proceeds, carrying và selling cost?
Recurring reported EBITDA năm giao dịch, gồm H1 tower operations và H2 rent?
Reported EBIT theo P&L convention có disposal gain và D&A?
Pro forma recurring EBITDA nếu bán từ 1/1 theo định nghĩa?
qas.answer: 900−650−48=202 triệu USD; bỏ H1 rental margin 8.

qas.question: Cash cuối năm theo CFO, net sale proceeds, capex và debt repayment?
Vì sao cash 390 khác disposal gain 90?
qas.answer: 390 là proceeds net selling cost; gain còn trừ carrying 300, khoản phi tiền.

qas.question: Có nên cộng net proceeds vào recurring FCF để đo hiệu suất network?
qas.answer: Không. Sale là investing disposal một lần; CFO after rent 156, recurring FCF trước sale 36.

qas.question: Có tính lease liabilities sau transaction theo IFRS 16 từ 4m/tháng?
qas.answer: Không. Toy không capitalizes lease, thiếu lease term, options, discount rate và real-world assessment.

assumptions: USD million except local currency EUR million. Fictional airline Willow Jet. Toy EUR ticket prepayments translated at receipt date for historical contract liability; monetary EUR refund payable remeasured at closing after cancellation. No tax or hedging.

evidence.text: [Ticket receipts Jan1] EUR 50m prepaid for future flights. Rate 1.10 USD/EUR, no opening liability. Cash converted immediately to USD; contract liability initially 55m USD.

[Delivery] By Sep30 passengers use EUR 30m face of tickets, historical allocated consideration at 1.10. EUR 10m face remains valid for next year; EUR 10m cancelled and becomes refundable cash obligation on Oct1.

[FX schedule] Oct1 cancellation rate 1.20; year-end closing rate 1.25. Toy transfers cancelled EUR 10m obligation out of historical liability at 11m USD and recognizes refund payable at 12m, 1m FX/conversion loss. No refund paid yet.
[Expenses] Flown-service expense 24m USD, admin 5m, both cash paid. No other P&L or cash.
[Policy] Remaining nonmonetary prepaid service liability stays historical rate. Refund payable is monetary remeasured at closing; additional FX loss recognized P&L. No breakage.
[Cash] Opening USD cash 20m before tickets; no new receipts after initial prepayment. Cash refund due next year only.
[Draft] Accountant remeasures all EUR 20m undelivered ticket balances at closing FX and recognizes delivered ticket revenue using closing rate.

qas.question: Revenue đã earned từ EUR30 face tickets theo historical allocation?
Contract liability còn cho EUR10 valid next year?
Closing monetary refund payable sau FX remeasurement?
Tổng FX/conversion loss từ cancellation đến year-end?
PBT của các ticket và service expenses đã nêu?
Vì sao closing rate không dùng cho toàn bộ EUR20 chưa flown?
qas.answer: EUR10 valid là nghĩa vụ dịch vụ nonmonetary historical 11; EUR10 cancelled chuyển thành monetary cash payable 12,5. Hai scope khác nhau.

qas.question: Cash 46 cuối kỳ có phải revenue chưa earned?
qas.answer: Không. Cash=20+55−24−5=46, là tài sản; obligations cuối kỳ gồm service 11 và refund 12,5. Không đồng nhất cash với revenue.

qas.question: Có dự báo FX loss thêm đến ngày refund?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu payment date và tỷ giá khi settlement.

assumptions: USD million; thousand tonnes. Fictional Fen Orchard Grain. Toy grain elevator holds customer commodity in custody; only purchased grain is its inventory. Financing secured by owned commodity only. Storage fee earned on customer tonnes.

evidence.text: [Warehouse register] At year-end 100k tonnes physical grain: 65k customer custody, 35k owned inventory. Owned grain purchased at $240/t; NRV $250/t net. No other owned stock movements in toy.
[Custody agreement] Customers retain title and may withdraw. Average customer grain stored 60k tonnes throughout year, storage fee $30/t/year. No purchase option or right to pledge customer grain.
[Trading ledger] In addition to ending stock, 80k tonnes owned grain sold at $300/t, cost $230/t. All sales collected. Costs separate from ending inventory purchases.
[Credit line] Lender advances 70% of lower of cost and NRV of eligible owned ending grain. Facility fully drawn at reporting; no other collateral.
[Expense] Storage operations .9m, trading overhead 2m, group central .6m, no interest/tax this year. Storage fee fully collected.
[Cash] Ending owned stock purchased cash, no opening payable. Debt draw is financing not sales. No other balances needed.
[Deck] Operator treats all 100k physical tonnes as owned inventory at $240 and applies 70% advance against entire stock.

qas.question: Giá trị inventory thuộc sở hữu tại cuối kỳ theo lower-of-cost/NRV?
Giới hạn borrowing đủ điều kiện dựa vào owned ending grain?
Revenue từ storage custody trên average tonnes?
Trading gross profit trên 80k tonnes đã bán?
Total operating result gồm storage và trading overhead?
Tại sao physical stock count 100k không chứng minh owned inventory?
qas.answer: 65k là custody customer title, chỉ 35k thuộc công ty. Kiểm kê vật lý cần đối chiếu quyền sở hữu.

qas.question: Nếu lender advances 16,8 như deck, có được coi là supported borrowing theo agreement?
qas.answer: Không. Deck tính trên 100k×240, gồm 65k không eligible; supported limit 5,88.

qas.question: Có tính total cash cuối năm từ các khoản grain transactions?
qas.answer: Không. Opening cash, các cost/receipt ngoài đã nêu và thời điểm thanh toán overhead chưa đầy đủ.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Silver Fern University. Toy conditional donor grant is liability until matching requirement satisfied; once threshold met entire amount recognized as restricted contribution. Restricted spending releases restrictions only on qualifying use.

evidence.text: [Donor agreement] Donor pays 30m on Jan1, conditional on university raising at least 15m qualifying matching gifts by Dec31; if unmet all 30 refundable. Once met, gift restricted to lab equipment.

[Gift ledger] Verified cash matching gifts 12m from external donors restricted to lab; 4m internal transfer from general reserves not qualifying. Signed external pledge 5m not yet paid; toy condition requires cash received only.
[Subsequent event] Additional qualifying external cash 4m arrives Jan10 next year; no donor extension or waiver of Dec31 cutoff. Year-end condition therefore not met.
[Spending] Lab equipment purchases 8m paid using verified external matching cash, all qualifying. Equipment capitalized, ready next year; no depreciation. Remaining matching gifts still restricted.
[Operating budget] Unrestricted tuition earned 100m, operating expenses 90m; no other contribution, tax or net asset movements.
[Cash] Opening unrestricted cash 20m, restricted cash zero. Tuition and operating costs fully settled; internal transfer 4 merely designated, not donor restriction. No refund paid by Dec31.
[Draft] Rector recognizes 30+12+5+4 as lab gift revenue and calls all lab cash available for unrestricted budget.

qas.question: Matching cash thực đủ điều kiện tại 31/12?
qas.answer: 12 triệu USD; internal transfer 4 và pledge 5 không đủ.

qas.question: Conditional donor liability cuối kỳ của 30m?
Restricted matching gift balance còn chưa chi vào lab?
Lab equipment addition tại reporting date?
Total cash cuối năm gồm conditional donor cash, matching gifts và unrestricted operations?
qas.answer: 20+100−90+30+12−8=64 triệu USD; internal transfer không đổi total cash.

qas.question: Có dùng Jan10 receipt 4 để xác nhận điều kiện Dec31 retroactively?
qas.answer: Không. Condition cutoff đã qua; không extension/waiver. Subsequent receipt không thay year-end fact.

qas.question: Hãy phân biệt 30 conditional cash, 4 remaining restricted matching cash và general reserve designation.
qas.answer: 30 là refundable liability khi condition unmet; 4 matching restricted còn dành lab; internal designation 4 không phải external qualifying gift hoặc donor restriction.

qas.question: Có thể khẳng định donor sẽ cho phép giữ 30 dù deadline thất bại?
qas.answer: Không. Chưa có waiver, amended agreement hoặc subsequent resolution.

assumptions: USD million; thousand tonnes. Fictional Red Quartz Mining. Toy mine sells ore to wholly owned smelter; group eliminates intercompany sale; royalty assessed on externally benchmarked ore value, not internal invoice. Smelter sells finished metal externally.

evidence.text: [Mine standalone] Ore produced 500k tonnes, all sent to group smelter at internal price $120/t. Mine extraction cost 35m, no ending ore stock. Mine paid royalty based on internal invoice at 5% before audit.
[Royalty audit] Benchmark ore price $150/t; royalty base 500k×150; 5% rate. Additional assessment confirmed and unpaid at year-end. No penalties/tax other than royalty.
[Smelter] Uses all ore in same year, no inventories. External metal revenue 120m, conversion cost 25m, intercompany ore COGS 60m. No other revenues/costs.
[Consolidation] Eliminate matching mine revenue and smelter intercompany COGS 60. Group external royalty expense retained. Central expense 8m.
[Cash] External collections 115m, all extraction/conversion/central costs paid, royalty cash already 3m. No interest or other cash flows; opening AR zero.
[Deck] Mine director says increasing internal price to $150 automatically raises consolidated profit and eliminates additional royalty assessment.
[Risk] No benchmark policy for next year, no ore grade or transport data.

qas.question: Internal mine revenue theo invoice đã ghi?
Total royalty theo confirmed external benchmark audit?
Royalty payable bổ sung chưa trả?
Consolidated operating result sau elimination và external royalty?
Group operating cash generated từ disclosed external cash flows?
qas.answer: Tiền thu từ bên ngoài là 115 triệu USD. Trừ chi phí khai thác35, chế biến25, quản lý8 và royalty đã trả3: dòng tiền hoạt động = 44 triệu USD. Không trừ phần truy thu royalty chưa thanh toán.

qas.question: Nếu internal price đổi 120→150, có làm group revenue tăng 15?
qas.answer: Không. Internal sale và COGS tăng cùng 15 rồi bị eliminate; external revenue 120 không đổi. Royalty đã theo external benchmark 150.

qas.question: Có loại royalty 3,75 trong consolidation vì liên quan internal sale?
qas.answer: Không. Là nghĩa vụ với bên ngoài, không phải intercompany balance.

qas.question: Có kiểm chứng benchmark $150 là arm's-length cho tất cả shipment tương lai?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu grade, logistics, comparables và next-year policy.

assumptions: USD million; thousand certificates. Fictional Tide Willow Utility. Toy purchased and generated certificates held at stipulated costs; use FIFO by vintage for compliance retirement. Shortfall provision based on current purchase price; no tax.

evidence.text: [Opening inventory] 2024 vintage purchased certificates 40k, cost $50 each. Eligible for 2025 compliance. No other opening certificate balance.
[2025 activity] Generate 70k eligible certificates at assigned cost $20 each; purchase 30k at $60 each. All available for 2025 compliance or later sale.

[Compliance] Required surrender 100k certificates. At year end 90k actually retired: 40k opening vintage plus 50k generated. Remaining obligation 10k must be settled next year; 20k generated and 30k purchased held. Toy provision uses $65 market purchase price for unsurrendered 10k; does not offset inventory.
[Sale] Separate 10k certificates generated under a different noncompliance scheme sold for $80 each, cost $25 each, not included in the above 140k pool.
[P&L] Utility energy revenue 90m and operating costs 60m before certificate costs/sales/provision; no other expense.
[Policy] Certificate expense on retirement; inventory remains at cost until retirement/sale, no NRV decline. Provision separate for remaining unsatisfied obligation.
[Deck] Analyst removes all held certificates from inventory and reports 100k retired because sufficient stock exists.

qas.question: Expense của 90k certificates đã retire theo FIFO?
Closing inventory eligible certificates trước future retirement?
Provision cho 10k unsurrendered compliance requirement?
Gross profit separate noncompliance certificate sale?
Operating result gồm energy và certificate accounting đúng policy?
Vì sao held certificates không đồng nghĩa compliance đã hoàn tất?
qas.answer: Chỉ 90k đã retired; còn 10k obligation. Inventory và provision là hai balances khác nhau theo toy.

qas.question: Có lấy noncompliance certificates đã bán để bù eligible compliance shortfall?
qas.answer: Không. Scheme riêng và đã bán, không thuộc eligible pool.

qas.question: Có tính market value của toàn bộ inventory tại year-end chỉ dùng $65?
qas.answer: Không. $65 dùng shortfall provision, không chứng minh price cho từng vintage hoặc executable sale.
